<DOCSTRING>
Manages a list of users and processes them based on their age.

This class is used to create a new UserManager object to store and manage a collection of users. It initializes an empty list to hold the users and processes each user based on whether they are an adult or a minor.
</DOCSTRING>

<DOCSTRING>
Adds a user to the list and processes them.

Args:
    user (User): The user object to add and process.

Returns:
    void: This function does not return a value.
</DOCSTRING>

<DOCSTRING>
Processes a user based on their age.

Args:
    user (User): The user object to process.

Returns:
    void: This function does not return a value.
</DOCSTRING>

<DOCSTRING>
Handles an adult user by printing their name.

Args:
    user (User): The user object to check.

Returns:
    void: This function does not return a value.
</DOCSTRING>

<DOCSTRING>
Handles a minor user by printing a message indicating they are a minor.

Args:
    user (User): The user object containing the name attribute.

Returns:
    void: This function does not return a value.
</DOCSTRING>

<DOCSTRING>
A list of users.

Type: List[User]
Purpose: Holds the collection of users managed by the UserManager.
</DOCSTRING>
